name: Database Specialist Examination
name_ja: データベーススペシャリスト試験 (DB)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, once yearly (October)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: National recognition and deep database design/security support professional domain decisions at three years; local scope and partial security coverage do not establish general security expertise.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Deep database design and security coverage with a three-year profile supports professional database responsibility. The national exam offers knowledge assurance, while local recognition and partial security coverage limit its broader cyber hiring value.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded depth in database design and security fits professional domain decisions at three years. Its database emphasis and domestic paper assessment limit broader cybersecurity or expert inferences.
